name: Kimura Seiko
source: Kimura Seiko is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 4 Director. Her responsibility as the director is the research and development of new medical techniques. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.
